actions.inlineHint: Deleting will copy the definition into each dependent test so they keep working.

topology.title: Topology
topology.derived: Derived by the server from the params — machines per role and data flows.
topology.empty: No topology yet — pick a kind and params.

requirements.title: Hardware requirements
requirements.derived: Minimal CPU / memory / disk per role, computed from params and workload.
requirements.empty: No hardware requirements — external or no-op target.

usages.title: Where it is used
usages.hint: Tests and suites that reference this {{kind}}. Delete is blocked while it is in use.
usages.emptyDatabase: No test uses this database yet. Create a test to run it.
usages.emptyWorkload: No test uses this workload yet.
usages.emptyTest: This test is not part of any suite or schedule.

validation.title: Validation
validation.doesNotFit_one: Does not fit — {{count}} error to fix.
validation.doesNotFit_other: Does not fit — {{count}} errors to fix.

import.title: Import {{kind}}
import.hint: Paste a YAML or JSON document with kind: {{kind}}, or drop a file. The record is created as-is and validated by the server.
import.notDocument: Expected a document with kind, metadata and spec.

diff.title: Compare with another record
diff.hint: Pick another record of the same kind to see field-by-field changes.

sizes.noDiskHint: This role uses the default boot disk.

segments.title: Segments
segments.hint: Segments run one after another on the same stand — e.g. load, then OLTP, then OLAP.
segments.name: Name

options.title: Driver, connection, baseline
options.hint: stroppy runtime options; defaults apply for everything you leave untouched.

configs.title: Software configs per role
configs.hint: Only deviations from the schema defaults are stored; the form shows the full effective config.
configs.overviewHint: Config schemas per role and how many keys deviate from the defaults.
configs.none: No config schemas for this kind.
configs.allDefault: Everything is at its default. Turn on “Show all fields” to change something.

databases.title: Databases
databases.subtitle: Database definitions: engine, version, topology and tuning. Hardware is chosen in the test.
databases.schemaMissing: Schema {{id}} is not in the catalog.

empty.title: No databases yet
empty.hint: Describe a database once, then reuse it in tests and suites.

workloads.title: Workloads
workloads.subtitle: stroppy workloads: version, protocol and the segments to run.

empty.title: No workloads yet
empty.hint: Describe a workload once, then pair it with databases in tests.

form.protocolHint: Protocols the chosen version can speak; must match the database kind.
form.firstSegmentHint: More segments can be added on the workload page.
form.runnerHint: Runner machine size follows the largest VU count.

tests.title: Tests
tests.subtitle: Database × workload × sizes, ready to launch as runs.
tests.trendHint_one: {{count}} completed run with a headline metric.
tests.trendHint_other: {{count}} completed runs with a headline metric.
tests.noRunsHint: Launch the test to see its history here.
tests.revalidatedIssues: Validated — there are issues to fix.
tests.draftCannotLaunch: Finish the wizard first — a draft cannot be launched.
tests.sizesHint: Requirement per role vs the chosen size. Override at launch if needed.

empty.title: No tests yet
empty.hint: A test pairs a database with a workload and sizes. Create one to launch runs.

tests.finalizeHint: Open the last wizard step and validate the test

launch.title: Launch {{name}}
launch.subtitle: Overrides apply to this run only; the test stays unchanged.
launch.providerHint: Only verified (ready) profiles can be used.
launch.sizesHint: Sizes for this run. Requirements are re-checked live.
launch.keepHint: Go duration (30m, 2h) to keep machines after the run; 0s tears down.
launch.labelsHint: Free key=value labels for filtering runs.

wizard.intro: Four steps: database → workload → sizes → review. A draft is saved after the first step.
wizard.draftHint: Draft is saved on the server after every step — you can come back later.
wizard.pickDatabaseHint: Use a library record (changes propagate) or describe one inline just for this test.
wizard.pickWorkloadHint: The protocol must match the database kind — the server checks it.
wizard.protocolsHint: Pick a workload whose protocol {{kind}} accepts.
wizard.providerHint: Optional — can be chosen at launch instead. Suites pick their own.
wizard.sizesHint: Suggested sizes are the smallest that fit. Bigger is fine.

db.name: Name
db.templateHint: Presets the params; everything can be tuned on the next step.
